property_summary: For any caller, after depositing via addToBalance, the view getBalance(caller) must return the deposited amount; the bug makes getBalance return the balance of the caller of getBalance (tx.origin/msg.sender) rather than the queried address, so querying a funded address from a different unfunded caller returns 0 instead of the correct amount.
change_summary: Replace return statement to return balance of msg.sender instead of argument u.
